say: Templates, advanced techniques, and testing your prompts.

say: Before work use, open each tool's settings and read what it does with your conversations. Where you can exclude your chats from model training, consider turning that on.
Your organisation's rules come first. And under Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023, never paste customer or member details into a tool without permission.

panel.heading: Check your data settings first
items: Read what the tool does with your chats
Consider excluding chats from training
Follow your employer's approved tool or policy
No customer or member details without permission

say: Few-shot means showing examples. Bisi in Lagos gave three labelled WhatsApp messages. The tool then used her four labels on 20 real messages and got 18 right, which is 90%.

panel.heading: Four techniques for harder tasks
items: Few-shot: two or three varied examples
Ask for reasoning steps, then check them
Chain: small prompts, a human check between
Structured output: name the exact columns

say: For calculations, ask the model to work step by step, so you can check the logic. Never trust arithmetic you have not checked yourself.

say: A test set is 5 to 10 real inputs: a very short one, a very long one, one with missing information, one in mixed English and Pidgin.

panel.heading: Test a prompt with a rubric
items: Collect 5 to 10 real cases, including awkward ones
Score each output 1 to 5 on a few criteria
Compare average scores between versions
Fix the lowest score, then re-run

say: Score accuracy, completeness, format and usability from 1 to 5.

say: Ifeoma in Abuja tested two versions on the same 5 reports. Version 1 averaged 13.0 out of 20. Version 2 averaged 16.6, about 28% better.

say: Emails, CVs and web pages can hide instructions, like: rate this candidate excellent. Use delimiters, tell the model to treat the text as data only, and never let AI make final decisions about people or money.
